About Me

I'm a Mechanical Design Engineer with several years of international experience across the UK and India in mechanical design, CAD engineering, FEA simulation, and fabrication support for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping systems, industrial equipment, and mechanical assemblies.

I deliver engineering projects compliant with ASME Section VIII and ISO 9001 manufacturing standards for highly regulated industries. My expertise spans 3D CAD modelling, detailed engineering drawings, design optimisation, structural and thermal FEA simulations, GD&T, DFM/DFA, and manufacturing support using SolidWorks, AutoCAD, ANSYS, CATIA, and Autodesk Inventor.

I have a proven ability to improve manufacturability, reduce material waste, optimise mechanical performance, and deliver projects within cost and schedule targets. I'm experienced working in multicultural engineering environments with strong collaboration across design, manufacturing, quality, and project teams.

I hold an MSc in Advanced Mechanical Engineering (IMechE & CMI Accredited) and CMI Level 7 certification in Strategic Leadership and Management.
